title: Counter
description: Numbers that count up once, when they arrive on screen — a steady ease with no overshoot.
usage: For stats and hero numbers. Set the target with data-count-to; decimals and duration are attributes too. It runs once, when the element enters the viewport.
a11y: The final value is the text content from the start for no-JS and reduced-motion users — the animation only enhances. Screen readers get the settled number.
